_about: Measured simulation, not applied. Conflicts, stage statuses, rosters, identities, episodes and finals untouched. Repository data unchanged.

generic_matrix_observation.finding: A house (exhibition) bout is counted "verified" when a LATER professional bout between the same two fighter ids has the same winner (dbVerified in completeness_matrix.mjs does not require the result row to be the house bout itself). Reported only; no matrix rule changed.
